reference_sql:
WITH store_revenue AS (
  -- one row per physical store with an order from January to June 2025
  SELECT s.store_code, s.country_code,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND s.store_type <> 'web'
  GROUP BY s.store_code, s.country_code
)
SELECT store_code, country_code, net_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * net_revenue_eur / SUM(net_revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code), 1) AS country_share_pct
FROM store_revenue
ORDER BY store_code

SELECT sr.store_code, sr.country_code, sr.net_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * sr.net_revenue_eur / cr.country_revenue_eur, 1) AS country_share_pct
FROM store_revenue AS sr
JOIN country_revenue AS cr ON cr.country_code = sr.country_code
ORDER BY sr.store_code

SELECT DISTINCT s.store_code, s.country_code,
       SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_code) AS net_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY s.store_code)
             / SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY s.country_code), 1) AS country_share_pct
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND s.store_type <> 'web'
ORDER BY s.store_code

WITH rev AS (
  SELECT s.store_code, s.country_code,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_type <> 'web'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY s.store_code, s.country_code
)
SELECT store_code, country_code, net_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * net_revenue_eur / SUM(net_revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code), 1) AS country_share_pct
FROM rev
ORDER BY store_code ASC
